text:
maria.p: Hey team — starting a thread to collect feedback on the 'kernel prefetch + kv policy' RFC I'm drafting. Goal: decide launch priority, acceptance criteria, and customer-driven scope. TL;DR: two customer asks (low-latency chat for fintech customer, and high-throughput embed batch for search customer).

devin.k: :eyes: sharing notes shortly. We should separate the runtime-change vs config-exposure parts.

raj: Agree. For runtime change we need perf matrix across seq lengths: 16, 128, 1024. Also memory regressions.

sophia: For the fintech customer, latency p50 and p99 targets are strict: p50 <= 20ms token, p99 <= 150ms for 128 tokens. They also need deterministic fallbacks.

alan.sre: Add rollback triggers: CPU/GPU memory >80% for 5m, 5% error rate increase, and latency p99 regression >20% vs baseline.

maria.p: Good. I'll add those to acceptance criteria. Also thinking about canary plan: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h with automated health checks.

devin.k: Can we draft the config snippet we'll expose? e.g.

```
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_tokens: 64
kernel_selection:
  algorithm: 'latency-aware'
  prefer_quantized: true
kv_cache:
  eviction_policy: 'lru'
  max_entries_per_shard: 200000
```

raj: That looks fine. Note: prefer_quantized means we must test quality drop for Llama2-70B-Chat-v1.

sophia: Acceptance criteria idea: no more than 2% avg degradation in generation quality (BLEU/ROUGE or eval harness) for top customer prompts.

alan.sre: Observability items: per-kernel latency histograms, kv hit rate, prefetch hit rate, memory per-request. Add tracing tag for kernel_variant.

qa-bot: CI plan — add perf regression suite that runs on a 3k token mix, simulates batching levels 1/8/32. Fail on >10% cost increase or >10% latency p99 increase.

maria.p: On scope negotiation: proposal is to ship kernel runtime and kv policy internal defaults first, then expose tuned knobs to Dedicated in v1.1. Private deployments later due to config surface.

devin.k: Risk: exposing too many knobs will create support burden. Recommend only 3 exposed: prefetch.enabled, kernel.algorithm, kv.eviction_policy.

raj: Edge case: prefix caching + prefetch + very long context may cause double-counting of KV size. Need eviction accounting in dispatcher.

sophia: Customer ask: ability to pin kernel variant per model version. Add to rollout wishlist but not launch-blocker.

alan.sre: Monitoring alert thresholds and automated fallback to baseline kernel will be needed for graceful degradation.

maria.p: Next steps: I'll update RFC with acceptance criteria, canary plan, config snippet, SLOs, and open PR. Please review by EOD Friday. If no major objections we'll cut PRD for PM review next Monday.

devin.k: I'll add perf numbers and an evaluation run for Llama family tomorrow.

raj: I'll prototype eviction accounting patch and share small benchmark.

sophia: I'll collect customer prompt set for quality tests.

maria.p: Thanks all. Tagging @devin.k @raj @sophia for action items. :thumbsup:
